heading.en: Origins and rise

body.zh-Hant: 吳佩孚是中國直隸派軍閥的政治家，出身山東省。他年輕時投身軍隊，後來進入保定的軍事學堂（《日本大百科全書》作保定武備學堂，《世界大百科事典》作保定軍官學校），在袁世凱部下曹錕麾下嶄露頭角，並以直隸派的身分在民國以後的軍閥混戰中建立大勢力。據《世界大百科事典》，他字子玉，是蓬萊縣人，23歲成為生員。
body.en: Wu Peifu was a politician and warlord of the Zhili clique from Shandong Province. He joined the army when young and later entered a military school at Baoding (the Nipponica says the Baoding Military Preparatory School, the World Encyclopedia says the Baoding Military Academy). He rose under Cao Kun, a subordinate of Yuan Shikai, and built up great power as part of the Zhili clique in the warlord wars after the founding of the Republic. The World Encyclopedia gives his courtesy name as Ziyu, his home as Penglai County, and says he became a licentiate at 23.

citations.quote: 中国、山東(さんとう／シャントン)省出身の政治家。若くして軍隊に投じ、のち保定武備学堂を卒業。
袁世凱(えんせいがい)部下の軍閥曹錕(そうこん／ツァオクン)をかつぎ、
中華民国以後の軍閥混戦のなかで、直隷派(ちょくれいは)として大きな勢力を築き上げた。
中国の軍閥，山東省蓬萊県の人。字は子玉。
23歳で生員，のち保定軍官学校へ進み，曹錕（そうこん）の下で頭角をあらわした。

heading.en: The Anhui–Zhili and Zhili–Fengtian wars

body.zh-Hant: 1920年，吳佩孚趕走了受日本支持的安徽派段祺瑞（安直戰爭）；1922年又趕走了同樣受日本影響的奉天派張作霖（第一次奉直戰爭）。他以賄賂選舉讓曹錕當上大總統，在北京政界舉足輕重。《世界大百科事典》則說，直隸派在1920至1924年掌握政權，他是該派的驍將。
body.en: In 1920 Wu drove out Duan Qirui of the Anhui clique, who was backed by Japan (the Anhui–Zhili War), and in 1922 drove out Zhang Zuolin of the Fengtian clique, who was likewise under Japanese influence (the First Zhili–Fengtian War). Through a bribed election he brought Cao Kun to the presidency and carried weight in Beijing politics. The World Encyclopedia adds that the Zhili clique held power in 1920–24 and that he was its dashing general.

citations.quote: まず1920年、日本に後押しされた安徽(あんき)派の段祺瑞(だんきずい／トワンチールイ)を追い（安直戦争）、
1922年にはやはり日本の影響下にあった奉天派の張作霖(ちょうさくりん／チャンツオリン)を追って（第一次奉直戦争）、
賄賂(わいろ)選挙によって曹錕大総統を実現し、北京(ペキン)政界に重きをなした。
直隷派の驍将として同派の政権掌握（1920-24）に功があった。

heading.zh-Hant: 京漢鐵路罷工與第二次奉直戰爭
heading.en: The Beijing–Hankou strike and the Second Zhili–Fengtian War

body.zh-Hant: 1923年，吳佩孚對京漢線鐵路工人的罷工施以大鎮壓，《世界大百科事典》稱之為二七屠殺。1924年他再度與奉天派作戰，卻因馮玉祥倒戈而敗退（第二次奉直戰爭）。其後他未能東山再起；《世界大百科事典》說他敗於北伐軍而退出第一線。
body.en: In 1923 Wu brutally suppressed the strike of Beijing–Hankou railway workers, which the World Encyclopedia calls the February 7 massacre. In 1924 he again fought the Fengtian clique but was routed when Feng Yuxiang changed sides (the Second Zhili–Fengtian War). He never recovered afterwards; the World Encyclopedia says he was beaten by the Northern Expedition army and withdrew from the front line.

citations.quote: 1923年、京漢(けいかん)線の鉄道労働者のストライキに大弾圧を加え、
1923年の二・七虐殺（京漢鉄道ストライキ）にみられるように
1924年、ふたたび奉天派と戦ったが、馮玉祥(ふうぎょくしょう／フォンユイシヤン)の寝返りで敗退（第二次奉直戦争）。
その後は再起することができず、
北伐軍に敗れて第一線を退き，

heading.en: Later years and posthumous honour

body.zh-Hant: 1932年起，吳佩孚隱居北京。《日本大百科全書》說，日軍占領下他一度被迫加入傀儡政權，但只是掛名，完全不予協助，在抗日戰爭中病逝；《世界大百科事典》則說他沒有應日本拉他出山的工作，死後國民政府追贈他一級上將。兩書都記他卒於1939年。
body.en: From 1932 Wu lived in retirement in Beijing. The Nipponica says that under Japanese occupation he was briefly made to take part in a puppet regime but only in name, gave no cooperation at all, and died of illness during the war of resistance; the World Encyclopedia says he did not respond to Japanese attempts to bring him out, and that the Nationalist Government posthumously conferred the rank of first-class general on him. Both give 1939 as his year of death.

citations.quote: 1932年から北京に隠棲(いんせい)した。
日本軍占領下で一時傀儡(かいらい)政権に参加させられたが、名目だけにとどまって、いっさい協力せず、
抗日戦争中に病死した。
のち日本の担ぎ出し工作には応じなかった。
死後，国民政府から一級上将を追贈された。

heading.zh-Hant: 主要戰役：安直戰爭與兩次奉直戰爭
heading.en: Major campaigns: the Anhui–Zhili War and the two Zhili–Fengtian Wars

body.zh-Hant: 據《ブリタニカ国際大百科事典》，吳佩孚在1920年的安直戰爭中擊破段祺瑞之軍，1922年第一次奉直戰爭中勝張作霖，成為直隸派軍閥的巨頭；1924年第二次奉直戰爭中則告戰敗。官職資料庫收錄的任命令顯示，他於1924年9月17日被特派為討逆軍總司令，同年10月24日被免去直魯豫巡閱使兼陸軍第三師師長等本兼各職。這幾場戰役構成他軍事生涯的主軸。
body.en: According to the Britannica International Encyclopedia, Wu Peifu defeated Duan Qirui's army in the Anhui–Zhili War of 1920, beat Zhang Zuolin in the First Zhili–Fengtian War of 1922 and became the leading figure of the Zhili clique, but was defeated in the Second Zhili–Fengtian War of 1924. The government-gazette appointment database shows that on 17 September 1924 he was specially appointed Commander-in-Chief of the Punitive Army, and that on 24 October 1924 he was relieved of his substantive and concurrent posts, including Inspector-General of Zhili, Shandong and Henan and Commander of the 3rd Division. These campaigns formed the core of his military career.

heading.en: Origins and the air force system

body.zh-Hant: 周至柔是浙江省臨海縣人，保定軍校第8期畢業，1925年赴廣州黃埔軍校擔任教官。研究者指出他主持空軍甚久，曾任航空委員會主任、中央航空學校校長；任期起迄來源未寫。
body.en: Zhou Zhirou was a native of Linhai County in Zhejiang, a graduate of the 8th class of the Baoding Military Academy, and in 1925 went to the Whampoa Military Academy in Guangzhou as an instructor. A researcher notes that he led the air force for a long time and served as director of the Aeronautical Commission and president of the Central Aviation School; the sources give no dates for these terms.

citations.quote: 周至柔，浙江省臨海縣人，保定軍校第 8 期畢業，1925 年赴廣州黃埔軍校擔任教官。
他主持空軍甚久，曾任航空委員會主任、中央航空學校校長，

heading.en: First Commander-in-Chief of the Air Force

body.zh-Hant: 1946年中華民國空軍正式成立，周至柔被任命為第一任空軍總司令，同時兼軍事委員會委員長侍從室主任。國防部空軍司令部官網的歷任司令名單將他列為首任司令，任期為1946年6月1日至1952年3月14日。
body.en: In 1946 the Republic of China Air Force was formally established and Zhou Zhirou was appointed its first Commander-in-Chief, concurrently serving as director of the Chairman's attendant office of the Military Affairs Commission. The Air Force Command's official list of commanders names him the first Commander-in-Chief, with a term from 1 June 1946 to 14 March 1952.

citations.quote: 1946 年中華民國空軍正式成立， 周至柔被任命第一任空軍總司令兼軍事委員會委員長侍從室主任。
General Zhou Zhi-Rou, 1st Commander-in-Chief
(term of office: June 1, 1946 to March 14, 1952)

heading.zh-Hant: 參謀總長與政治行動委員會
heading.en: Chief of the General Staff and the Political Action Committee

body.zh-Hant: 1950年3月，蔣中正總統任命周至柔擔任參謀總長，兼空軍總司令。同年8月，政治行動委員會改由周至柔擔任主任委員；然而實際工作由蔣經國接手，周至柔除了一年一度在工作檢討會上露面外，其他事情概不過問。
body.en: In March 1950 President Chiang Kai-shek appointed Zhou Zhirou Chief of the General Staff while he remained Air Force Commander-in-Chief. In August of the same year the Political Action Committee came under Zhou as chairman, but the actual work was taken over by Chiang Ching-kuo, and Zhou apart from appearing at the annual work review took no part in other matters.

heading.en: Governor of Taiwan Province and Chief of the Presidential Military Staff

body.zh-Hant: 據蘇聖雄論文注文，國防會議秘書長由周至柔改為文人張羣，周至柔調任臺灣省政府主席，更遠離軍事相關職務。後來他被解除省主席職務，改任參軍長，此後未再擔任政府要職；他曾以總統府參軍長身分與陳誠討論辭去行政院長之事。
body.en: According to a footnote in Su Sheng-hsiung's paper, the post of Secretary-General of the National Defense Council passed from Zhou Zhirou to the civilian Zhang Qun, and Zhou was transferred to be Chairman of the Taiwan Provincial Government, moving further from military posts. He was later relieved as provincial chairman and made Chief of the Presidential Military Staff, and thereafter held no major government post; as the president's Chief of Military Staff he discussed with Chen Cheng how Chen could resign as premier.

heading.en: Background

body.zh-Hant: 唐生智生於1889年、卒於1970年，畢業於保定軍官學校。David Askew 形容他是虔誠的佛教徒、前軍閥。1937年冬日軍直逼南京之際，他曾激昂地力主一戰。
body.en: Tang Shengzhi (1889–1970) was a graduate of the Paoting (Baoding) Military Academy. David Askew describes him as a devout Buddhist and an ex-warlord. In the winter of 1937, as Japanese forces rushed toward Nanjing, he made an emotional plea to fight.

citations.quote: 唐生智 (1889- 1970), graduate of the Paoting Military Academy
graduate of the Paoting Military Academy, devout Buddhist, ex-warlord
made an emotional plea to fight, saying:
Through the winter of 1937, as the Japanese Central China Expeditionary Army
rushed towards Nanking, the capital of Nationalist China from 1927

heading.en: The Northern Expedition and the Nanjing–Wuhan split

body.zh-Hant: 1926年8月起，共產黨結合北伐中崛起的反蔣派系，並支持親汪的軍人唐生智，以抑制蔣中正的勢力（黃克武引述李志毓之說）。北伐前期，奉軍退出鄭州後，唐生智占領許昌；其後蔣中正自徐州撤回長江南岸，而唐生智率東征軍向南京推進，與孫傳芳形成夾擊之勢。王正華並說，唐生智、汪兆銘的「反蔣」情結使馮玉祥主持的開封會議無功而返。
body.en: From August 1926, according to Huang Kewu citing Li Zhiyu, the Communists allied with the anti-Chiang factions that had risen during the Northern Expedition and also backed the pro-Wang Jingwei officer Tang Shengzhi to restrain Chiang Kai-shek's power. In the early Northern Expedition, after the Fengtian army left Zhengzhou, Tang took Xuchang; later, as Chiang pulled back from Xuzhou to the south bank of the Yangtze, Tang led the eastern expeditionary army toward Nanjing, forming a pincer with Sun Chuanfang. Wang Zhenghua adds that the anti-Chiang feeling of Tang and Wang Jingwei brought Feng Yuxiang's Kaifeng conference to nothing.

citations.quote: 此一運動從 1926 年 8 月即開始，共產黨結合在廣東及北伐中崛起的反蔣派系，又支持親汪的軍人唐生智，抑制蔣中正的勢力。
即奉軍退出鄭州，唐生智占領許昌，蔣乃電李宗仁速占徐州。
而唐生智率東征軍向南京推進，和孫傳芳形成夾擊之勢。
然唐生智、汪兆銘的「反蔣」情結，終致使馮開封會議無功而寂。

heading.en: The defence of Nanjing

body.zh-Hant: 唐生智被任命為負責防衛首都的部隊指揮官，Askew 的附表稱他為首都衛戍部隊司令（Commander, Capital Garrison Forces）；Askew 也稱他為中國方面的總司令（Chinese Commander-in-Chief）。據該文，唐生智最後統率的部隊構成見其附表。Askew 把南京之戰定義為12月6、7日起至12月13日。
body.en: Tang was appointed commander of the forces charged with defending the capital, and Askew's chart labels him Commander, Capital Garrison Forces; Askew also calls him the Chinese Commander-in-Chief. According to the paper, the forces eventually entrusted to him are set out in the paper's Chart 1. Askew defines the battle for Nanjing as the period from 6–7 December until 13 December.

heading.zh-Hant: 衛戍司令長官與南京保衛戰役
heading.en: Garrison commander and the Battle of Nanjing

body.zh-Hant: 官職資料庫收錄的任命令顯示，國民政府於民國26年（1937年）11月24日特派唐生智為南京衛戍司令長官。Askew 把南京這場戰役的戰期定義為12月6、7日起至12月13日，並稱唐生智為中國方面的總司令（Chinese Commander-in-Chief）。此前，唐生智自同年9月8日起擔任軍事委員會軍事執法總監。
body.en: The government-gazette appointment database shows that on 24 November 1937 (ROC year 26) the National Government specially appointed Tang Shengzhi Commander of the Nanjing Garrison. Askew defines the battle for Nanjing as the period from 6–7 December until 13 December and calls Tang the Chinese Commander-in-Chief. Earlier, from 8 September of that year, Tang had been Inspector-General of Military Law Enforcement of the Military Affairs Commission.

heading.en: Formation of the New 38th Division

body.zh-Hant: 新編第38師的前身是國府財政部稅警總團，該團參加過1937年的淞滬會戰。1942年1月，以總團6個團中的第2、3、4團改編為新編第38師，總團長孫立人改任師長，副總團長齊學啟改任副師長，納入第66軍序列，準備入緬作戰。
body.en: The New 38th Division grew out of the Tax Police General Corps of the Nationalist Government's Ministry of Finance, which had fought in the 1937 Battle of Shanghai. In January 1942 the corps's 2nd, 3rd and 4th regiments were reorganised into the New 38th Division; corps commander Sun Li-jen became division commander and deputy commander Qi Xueqi became deputy division commander, the division being placed under the 66th Army in preparation for Burma.

citations.quote: 新編第38師的前身，是國府財政部稅警總團，參加過1937年的「淞滬會戰」；
1942年1月，以總團6個團中的第2、3、4團，改編為新編第38師，總團長孫立人改任師長，副總團長齊學啟改任副師長，納入第66軍序列，準備入緬作戰。

heading.en: Entering Burma

body.zh-Hant: 1942年3月11日，該師到達貴州興義誓師，同月28日起以車運入緬；4月5日全師到達臘戍。4月7日，新38師除留置114團第1營警衛臘戍機場外，全師向曼德勒推進。
body.en: On 11 March 1942 the division reached Xingyi in Guizhou for its oath-taking rally and from the 28th began moving into Burma by vehicle; the whole division arrived at Lashio on 5 April. On 7 April, apart from leaving the 114th Regiment's 1st Battalion to guard Lashio airfield, the division advanced toward Mandalay.

citations.quote: 同年3月11日，該師由駐地到達貴州興義誓師，
並於28日起車運入緬；4月5日，全師到達臘戍。
4月7日，新38師除留置114團第1營，警衛臘戍機場外，全師向曼德勒推進。

heading.en: The Battle of Yenangyaung

body.zh-Hant: 何世同指出，1942年的仁安羌之戰開始於3月25日，日軍第33師團沿伊洛瓦底江北進，結束於4月20日，國軍解救仁安羌英軍脫困後離開戰場。他把「新編第38師第113團奮勇解救英軍」視為這場作戰的卓越表現，稱這是中國自甲午戰爭以降，首次在境外擊敗日軍、解救盟軍。第113團團長為劉放吾上校；該文也引述《抗日戰史》，稱被圍英軍約七千餘人傍晚均獲解救。
body.en: Ho Shih-tung writes that the Battle of Yenangyaung of 1942 began on 25 March, when the Japanese 33rd Division advanced north along the Irrawaddy, and ended on 20 April, when the Chinese army left the field after rescuing the British force. He counts the 113th Regiment of the New 38th Division's bold rescue of the British as an outstanding performance, calling it the first time since the Sino-Japanese War of 1894 that China defeated Japanese troops outside its borders and rescued allies. The 113th Regiment's commander was Colonel Liu Fangwu; the paper also quotes the Kang-Jih chan-shih as saying roughly 7,000 besieged British troops were all rescued by evening.

citations.quote: 1942年的「仁安羌之戰」，開始於3月25日，日軍第33師團沿伊洛瓦底江北進；
結束於4月20日，國軍解救仁安羌英軍脫困後，脫離戰場。
另一次是劉放吾新編第38師第113團奮勇解救英軍的「攻擊戰鬥」。
首次在境外擊敗日本侵略主義者軍隊，解救盟軍，
新編第38師第113團團長劉放吾上校，
被圍之英軍全部約七千餘人，傍晚均獲解救，

heading.zh-Hant: 戰後史述與陸軍總司令
heading.en: Later historiography and the Army commandership

body.zh-Hant: 何世同認為，由於國民政府因內戰失敗退到臺灣而忽略緬戰戰史整理，加上對真相的刻意掩蓋與扭曲，以及1955年「孫立人案」的影響，這段歷史變得各說各話。蘇聖雄則列出遷臺初期軍令系統中有權勢者，包括陸軍總司令孫立人；何文注文也提到孫立人任陸軍總司令一事，但來源未寫其任期起迄。
body.en: Ho argues that because the Nationalist government, defeated in the civil war, withdrew to Taiwan and neglected the compilation of Burma war history, and because of deliberate concealment and distortion and the effect of the 1955 "Sun Li-jen case", the history became a matter of conflicting accounts. Su Sheng-hsiung lists among the powerful figures of the military command system in the early Taiwan years Army Commander-in-Chief Sun Li-jen; a footnote in Ho's paper also mentions Sun serving as Army Commander-in-Chief, but neither source gives the start or end of his term.

citations.quote: 由於抗戰勝利後不久，國民政府因內戰失敗而退到臺灣，忽略緬戰戰史的整理，
及1955年「孫立人案」之影響，致使這段歷史變得各說各話。
陸軍總司令孫立人、海軍總司令桂永清

heading.en: A Shanxi division commander in the Northern Expedition

body.zh-Hant: 楚溪春回憶，北伐時期閻錫山掛起青天白日旗後，出任國民革命軍第三集團軍總司令；當時晉軍已經擴充，師長有孫楚、傅作義、楊效歐等人。孫楚是閻錫山麾下的晉軍將領。
body.en: Chu Xichun recalls that in the Northern Expedition period, after Yan Xishan hoisted the Nationalist flag, he became commander-in-chief of the National Revolutionary Army's Third Army Group; the Shanxi army had by then expanded, and its division commanders included Sun Chu, Fu Zuoyi and Yang Xiaoou. Sun Chu was a general of Yan Xishan's Shanxi army.

citations.quote: 北伐战争时，阎锡山挂了青天白日旗以后，任国民革命军第三集团军总司令。
记得当时晋军的师长有孙楚、傅作义、杨效欧、傅存怀、王靖国、李生达、赵承绶、李培基、李服膺、孟兴富、关福安等人。

heading.en: Entering Beijing in 1928

body.zh-Hant: 胡平生指出，1928年6月8日，閻錫山的國民革命軍第三集團軍商震、張蔭梧、孫楚各部開入北京，北洋政府告終。該文把這件事放在1928年政局動盪的背景下敘述。
body.en: Hu Pingsheng writes that on 8 June 1928 the units of Shang Zhen, Zhang Yinwu and Sun Chu of Yan Xishan's National Revolutionary Army Third Army Group entered Beijing, ending the Beiyang government. The paper places this in the context of the political turmoil of 1928.

citations.quote: 是年六月八日，閻錫山之國民革命軍第三集團軍商震、張蔭梧、孫楚各部開入北京，北洋政府告終。
citations.evidenceNote: 「是年」承接同段「政局動盪的一九二八年」（原文）

citations.quote: 其中又以政局動盪的一九二八年為甚。

heading.en: Army groups during the war of resistance

body.zh-Hant: 抗日戰爭開始後，閻錫山出任第二戰區司令長官。1939年閻錫山實際兵力只剩第六集團軍；其後為維持面子，又向國民政府軍事委員會請增第八、第十三集團軍番號，其中第八集團軍總司令為孫楚，第十三集團軍總司令為王靖國。
body.en: After the war of resistance began, Yan Xishan became commander of the Second War Zone. By 1939 his actual strength was down to the Sixth Army Group alone; to keep up appearances he later asked the Military Affairs Commission to add the Eighth and Thirteenth Army Group designations, with Sun Chu as commander-in-chief of the Eighth Army Group and Wang Jingguo of the Thirteenth.

citations.quote: 抗日战争开始后，阎锡山任第二战区司令长官，
到了这个时候（1939年），阎锡山的实际兵力就剩下了一个第六集团军的兵力了。
新增加了第八，第十三集团军，
第八集团军总司令孙楚；

heading.en: The Iron Army and the Comrades' Association

body.zh-Hant: 楚溪春記得，晉軍「鐵軍」組織的最高領導人是閻錫山，「鐵委」包括楊愛源、王靖國、趙承綬、孫楚等人。後來「同志會」的「高幹」中，也有楊愛源、孫楚、趙承綬等人。
body.en: Chu Xichun remembers that the highest leader of the Shanxi army's "Iron Army" organisation was Yan Xishan, and that its "Iron Committee" included Yang Aiyuan, Wang Jingguo, Zhao Chengshou and Sun Chu. Later Yang Aiyuan, Sun Chu, Zhao Chengshou and others also served as senior cadres of the "Comrades' Association".

citations.quote: 这个铁军组织的最高领导人（会长）是阎锡山，
铁委有杨爱源（尔后升为副会长）、王靖国、赵承绶、孙楚、杨澄源、郭宗汾、彭毓斌、楚溪春等。
杨爱源、孙楚、王晋国、赵承绶、薄一波、戎子和、雷任民、韩钧等也都充当“同志会”的“高干”了。
